configurations.name: deploy-sim-backend
runtimeArgs: cd backend && set ACCESS_PASSWORD=local-sim-pass&& set DATA_DIR=..\data\sim&& set DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./data/sim/arven_ai.db&& set FRONTEND_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:5180&& set ALLOWED_HOSTS=*&& set PORT=8010&& .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m app
